description: "There is only one organization manager per organization" (spec, CreateOrgManager, read 2026-11-01), and the spec documents no answer for asking for a second, so a 409 surfaces as UnknownStackitError. The same operation says a failed create needs DeleteOrgManager before a retry, so a caller has to tell a create that broke halfway from one that was refused because a manager is already there: deleting on the second deletes someone else's manager. `Conflict` is what a 409 means on every other STACKIT API, and a real answer of another status changes nothing here. No live probe.
